module: Auxiliary rear wheel steering controller. In feedForward mode, it computes a rear steering output from a map (wheel speed, front steering) and publishes it in electrics.values.rws (configurable name) for a jbeam steering control to use. The closedLoop mode is not implemented.
notes: jbeam keys read: mode ("feedForward" or "closedLoop", default feedForward), rearSteeringOutputElectricsName ("rws"), feedForwardMapData (interpolatedMap data: x = speed in m/s, y = front steering electrics steering_input -> output), required in feedForward.
closedLoop: log W "not implemented" and updateGFX does nothing.
Invalid mode: log E but M.updateGFX receives nil.
Without feedForwardMapData: log E, init returns, the map stays nil and updateGFX (already assigned) will fail on the call to feedForwardMap:get.

updateGFX.desc: Assigned in init depending on the mode.

init.desc: Chooses the update function depending on the mode and loads the feedForward map.
